BlazerTech Character Management System

Character Preview

A Character Preview displays a live view of the character inside the Character Creation Menu.

Whenever a layer is modified, the preview updates automatically.

Character Preview Setup

  • For quick setup, use the Pre-Setup Prefabs.
  • To build your own, follow the Manual Setup.

Regardless of approach, additional configuration is required depending on the selected Preview Mode.

Preview Mode

Static

The simplest option. No Animator Controller is required.

  • Uses the Preview Sprite from the Character Creator Settings in the Layered Character Type.
  • Displays a single, non-animated image.

Animated

Uses an Animator Controller to animate the preview.

  • Assign the controller in Character Creator Settings → Preview Controller.
  • Requires an Animator component on the preview object.
  • Animations must be compatible with UI (Image component), not just Sprite Renderers.

Animator Controller Setup

The Animator Controller used for the Character Preview behaves differently depending on which features are enabled.

Basic Setup (No Controls)

If Rotation Controls and Animation Controls are NOT used:

  • The Animator Controller can be structured however desired.
  • The default animation will automatically play at runtime.
  • No parameters, transitions, or special setup are required.
Important

The Character Preview uses a UI Image component, not a Sprite Renderer.

This means:

  • Animations must target an Image component.
  • Existing animations that animate a Sprite Renderer must be duplicated or modified to also animate an Image.

Animation Controls Setup

Animation Controls allow switching between animations using UI buttons.

Configuration is defined in:

Layered Character Type → Character Creator Settings → Character Preview Animation Buttons

Each entry contains:

Field Description
Anim Name The exact name of the animation in the Animator Controller
Display Name The label shown to the player

Requirements

  • The Animator Controller must contain all animations referenced by Anim Name.
  • No transitions or state machine logic are required.
  • Animations are played directly by name at runtime.

Rotation Controls Setup

Rotation Controls allow the character to face different directions.

Required Parameter

Add the following parameter to the Animator Controller: Int: Direction

Direction Values

Value Direction
0 Forward
1 Backward
2 Left
3 Right

Behavior

  • Rotation buttons update the Direction parameter at runtime.
  • The Animator uses this value to determine which directional animation to play.

Recommended Setup (Rotation + Animation)

The recommended approach is to use Blend Trees.

Why Blend Trees

  • Allows a single animation (e.g. Idle, Walk) to support all directions.
  • Simplifies animation switching.
  • Avoids duplicating state logic.

Example Structure

  • State: Idle → Blend Tree (controlled by Direction)
  • State: Walk → Blend Tree (controlled by Direction)

Each Blend Tree:

  • Contains 4 motions (Forward, Backward, Left, Right)
  • Each motion is mapped to a Direction value

Result

  • Calling "Idle" plays the correct directional idle animation.
  • Changing Direction automatically updates the facing direction.

Default Direction

A Default Direction can be set in the Character Preview Handler.

  • Applied at runtime on initialization
  • Ensures the preview starts facing the correct direction

Prefabs

Location:
Prefabs > Character Creator > Modules > Character Preview

Pre-Setup Prefabs

Located in the Pre-Setup folder.

  • Character Preview
    Animated preview with no controls

  • Character Preview [+Rotation Controls]
    Adds left/right rotation buttons

  • Character Preview [+Rotation Controls, Anim Buttons]
    Includes both rotation and animation controls

Animation Controls Prefabs

Located in the Animation Controls folder.

Each variation includes:

  1. Animation Button
    A single button (not functional alone)

  2. Animation Controls [Initialize Existing]
    A complete set of buttons using CCM Animation Switcher

Setup

  • Assign the Character Preview Handler to the CCM Animation Switcher
  • Buttons initialize automatically at runtime

Manual Setup

Step 1: Create Preview Object

  1. Create a GameObject inside the Character Creation Menu
  2. Add:
    • CCM Character Preview Handler

Step 2: Select Preview Mode

Choose:

  • Static
  • Animated

If Animated:

  • Assign the Animator component
  • The Animator will receive the Preview Controller at runtime

Step 3: Assign Character Image

  • Assign a UI Image component
  • This is where the character is rendered using the Character Shader

Adding Rotation Controls

  1. Create a UI Button
  2. In OnClick, call: CCMCharacterPreviewHandler.RotateCharacterPreview(bool)
  • false → Rotate Left
  • true → Rotate Right

Create two buttons for full control.

Adding Animation Controls

Note

Requires Animated Preview Mode

  1. Create a GameObject
  2. Add CCM Animation Switcher
  3. Configure:
  • Animation Button Parent
  • Initialization Mode
    • Initialize Existing
    • Auto Create
  • Animation Button Prefab (if Auto Create)
  1. Assign:
  • Character Preview Handler

At runtime, buttons will control the currently playing animation.
